main_text.head: DEDICATIO.
main_text.p: inter nos cultæ: quam brevi in beata æternitate in complexu amicissimi Fratris & Servatoris nostri Iesu Christi cum tripudio glorificatorum cordium nostrorum nos continuaturos ut spero, ita confido. Deum veneror: ut renovet sicut Aquilæ annos senectæ vestræ, vosque, ubi certamen illud bonum certaveritis, cursumque stadij vestri consummaveritis, Paulinâ justitiæ corona beet. Scripsi Heidelbergæ Anno millesimo sexcentesimo decimo septimo, mense Augusto, cuius die vicesima quarta annum ætatis meæ ingredior quinquagesimum secundum, quem mihi felicem faustum & salutarem jubeat esse is, qui unicus Annalium horum scopus est Jesus Christus, benedictus in sempiterna secula, Amen.

page.notes: Lower part of the page is faded, with show-through and stains; the words "Lecto." are read as a catchword. The line "inter nos cultæ" opens with a fragment, so it is marked as continuing. "Scripsi HEIDELBERGÆ" uses small capitals, and "Amen" is in small capitals, rendered here in italics as a closing word. The lines "Lecto." and the faint marks below the text were partly illegible.
